neighbours.label: the token ' pro' (lowercase) as its own piece: Latin 'pro bono / pro rata / pro forma', 'pro|strate', 'a pro at'; not ' Pro', 'professional' or 'pros'
fire: The monks lay prostrate on the chapel floor through the night.
Her firm handles a dozen asylum cases pro bono every year.
Dividends are paid pro rata to all shareholders.
The worshippers bowed in prostration as the bell rang.
The supplier sent a pro forma invoice before shipping the goods.
The senator served as president pro tempore for two terms.
After ten years on the tour, he is a real pro at reading greens.
The grief left him prostrate for days after the funeral.
quiet: The monks lay flat on the chapel floor through the night.
Her firm handles a dozen asylum cases free of charge every year.
Dividends are paid in proportion to all shareholders.
The worshippers bowed in reverence as the bell rang.
The supplier sent a professional invoice before shipping the goods.
She upgraded to the iPad Pro for her illustration work.
After ten years on the tour, he is an expert at reading greens.
The committee listed the pros and cons of each proposal.

notes: Probes: prostrate 0.65, prostration 0.65, pro bono 0.45, pro rata 0.40, 'a pro at' 0.37, pro-democracy 0.30; 'MacBook Pro', 'professional', 'pros and cons' ~0. The card's other top examples (a digit after '(' in unit conversions, e.g. '(⟦3⟧35 km') did not reproduce in probes (<0.09), so the token label covers only part of the pole.
